title: 宀 roof (宝盖头)
intro: 宀 is a roof over the top of a character: a dot, a short left stroke, then a horizontal that hooks down. Characters with 宀 are about homes, rooms, shelter, safety, and things kept indoors.

ex.p: huān yíng lái wǒ jiā
ex.en: Welcome to my home.

ex.zh: 今天家里来了很多客人。
ex.p: jīn tiān jiā lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
ex.en: Lots of guests came to our home today.

ex.p: dà jiā dōu dào jiào shì le ma
ex.en: Has everyone arrived at the classroom?

ex.zh: 其实学汉字没有那么难。
ex.p: qí shí xué hàn zì méi yǒu nà me nán
ex.en: Actually, learning characters isn't that hard.

ex.zh: 学汉字不容易，但是很有意思。
ex.p: xué hàn zì bù róng yì dàn shì hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Learning characters isn't easy, but it's interesting.

ex.p: zhè gè zì zěn me xiě
ex.en: How do you write this character?

ex.p: tú shū guǎn lǐ yào ān jìng
ex.en: You have to be quiet in the library.

ex.zh: 晚上一个人走路不安全。
ex.p: wǎn shang yī gè rén zǒu lù bù ān quán
ex.en: Walking alone at night isn't safe.

ex.p: bàn gōng shì zài nǎr
ex.en: Where is the office?

ex.p: dà jiā dōu dào jiào shì le ma
ex.en: Has everyone arrived at the classroom?

ex.zh: 不客气，这是我应该做的。
ex.p: bù kè qi zhè shì wǒ yīng gāi zuò de
ex.en: You're welcome, it's the least I could do.

ex.zh: 今天家里来了很多客人。
ex.p: jīn tiān jiā lǐ lái le hěn duō kè rén
ex.en: Lots of guests came to our home today.

ex.zh: 我决定明年去中国留学。
ex.p: wǒ jué dìng míng nián qù zhōng guó liú xué
ex.en: I've decided to study abroad in China next year.

ex.p: wǒ yī dìng huì lái de
ex.en: I'll definitely come.

ex.p: zuò yè nǐ xiě wán le ma
ex.en: Have you finished your homework?

ex.p: tā men de bǎo bao hěn kě ài
ex.en: Their baby is very cute.

ex.p: tā zhù zài xué xiào de sù shè lǐ
ex.en: He lives in the school dorm.

ex.zh: 这个包裹寄到上海要多少钱？
ex.p: zhè gè bāo guǒ jì dào shǎng hǎi yào duō shǎo qián
ex.en: How much does it cost to mail this package to Shanghai?

ex.p: wǒ xiǎng jì yī fēng xìn
ex.en: I want to mail a letter.

ex.zh: 其实学汉字没有那么难。
ex.p: qí shí xué hàn zì méi yǒu nà me nán
ex.en: Actually, learning characters isn't that hard.

ex.p: qí shí wǒ bù máng
ex.en: Actually, I'm not busy.

ex.p: wǒ shí zài tài lěi le
ex.en: I'm really too tired.

ex.zh: 学汉字不容易，但是很有意思。
ex.p: xué hàn zì bù róng yì dàn shì hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: Learning characters isn't easy, but it's interesting.

ex.zh: 这本书的内容很有意思。
ex.p: zhè běn shū de nèi róng hěn yǒu yì si
ex.en: This book's content is interesting.

家.h: 宀 + 豕 (a pig under a roof)

安.h: 宀 + 女 (a woman under a roof)

宝.h: 宀 + 玉 (jade under a roof)

texts.title: 读一读 · 宀 roof (宝盖头)

lines.zh: 我叫大卫，现在住在大学的宿舍里。
lines.p: wǒ jiào dà wèi xiàn zài zhù zài dà xué de sù shè lǐ

lines.zh: 宿舍很安静，离教室也很近。
lines.p: sù shè hěn ān jìng chī jiào shì yě hěn jìn

lines.zh: 上个星期，我决定给家人寄一个礼物。
lines.p: shǎng gè xīng qī wǒ jué dìng gěi jiā rén jì yī gè lǐ wù

lines.zh: 我在一张卡片上写了很多汉字。
lines.p: wǒ zài yī zhāng kǎ piàn shǎng xiě le hěn duō hàn zì

lines.zh: 其实写汉字不容易，可是我一定要写完。
lines.p: qí shí xiě hàn zì bù róng yì kě shì wǒ yī dìng yào xiě wán

lines.zh: 妈妈收到以后，非常高兴。
lines.p: mā ma shōu dào yǐ hòu fēi cháng gāo xìng
